body:
Disclaimer: I wrote a nice long report originally and it got messed up so here is the bad version. I am not going to spend 30 minutes rewriting stuff I already did...





Ok, I had a nice long TR ready and I typed it in Internet Explorer and right when I was up to the standings at the end some @#$% IM’ed me and I hit back by accident (I have an optical mouse). This deleted all my progress and now I AM PISSED! Be prepared for a sucky report....



Ok, Brad has a charity tournament ready, only 14 people come because Mastic guys didn’t come. Oh well, Dan Sotelo and Derek Halpern are there and they haven’t played in like a year...



Game 1: My Ties VS. Jesse Sibler’s Old Mains deck

He’s from Albany and hasn’t played since Special Edition. He has no space and I spread and drain and block his draisn with spies and such and he loses because he can’t do anything about my drain of 6. I win by 21.

FW 2(+21)



Blah blah blah I had more stuff here before but damn people suck!!!!



Game 2: My WYS Vs. Dan Sotelo’s (1832) Black Sun

He gets out Guri with Xizor and Presence if the Force at the starting site to flip. I kill Zuckuss in space and Emperor and a Vigo go to my Cantina. I can’t do anything else and I die. I lose by 14.

FL 2(+7)



Game 3: My WYS Vs Wayne Cullen’s (1480 something) Maul deck

I kill Mara early and go to Kessel to drain. He then takes control of the ground and drained me for 4 a turn. I play On The Edge a few times and kill him off as he runs low on force. I win by 19.

FW 4(+26)



Game 4: My Ties Vs. Matt Ehrhart’s (1952) Podprofit

He has seen my deck already. He starts Battle Plan. I kill Artoo in ship early and he wins the race and spreads on the ground. He retrieves alot with On the Edge. I can’t pay to drain for long and I lose by 13.

FL 4(+13)



Prizes were good. Dan won and Matt got 2nd but both were 4 and 0. I got 7th out of 14.



Props:

Brad for a good tournament

Dan and Derek for coming although they haven’t played for a long long time

Dan and Brad for killer prizes

Dan for winning

Hoppers people for domination

Sam for the biggest comeback ever

Wayne for breaking 1500 finally



Slops:

Mastic people for not coming

Me for sucking

Sam for sucking even more



Super big slops:

Me: For not writing my original TR in Notepad or whatever

The person who IM’ed me about school and who messed up my original TR

Decktech: Popups are pissing me off big time. Three or four per page is 3 or 4 too many!

Optical mouse: Damn back button!



- Chris "I Am Pissed" Wo@#$%a

summary: Chris Wodicka finished 7th of 14 at a charity tournament in Levittown, New York, on 22 September 2001 with TIEs and WYS, going 2–2; Dan Sotelo won and Matt Ehrhart was 2nd, both 4–0.
notes: Same event as Matt Ehrhart's report d2985; both named 'September 2001 Levittown tournament' (new; no September 2001 Levittown event on the List or live). Run by Brad (surname not given); 14 players ('only 14 people come because Mastic guys didn't come').
Title withheld: slug words 'I Am Pissed' (mild swearing; treated like the withheld 'Damn' titles). The byline sign-off is 'Chris "I Am Pissed" Wo@#$%a' (censored in the body); byline gives Wodicka.

Game 2: Dan Sotelo's 'Black Sun' deck flips with Guri/Xizor/Presence of the Force at the starting site; linked to Agents Of Black Sun (the only Black Sun objective). Ehrhart's 'Podprofit' linked to You Can Either Profit By This....
Dan Sotelo and Jesse Sibler have no pages. Wayne Cullen and Matt Ehrhart linked to existing pages (Long Island players). Derek Halpern mentioned only in the intro and props.
Points lines cumulative: FW 2 (+21), FL 2 (+7), FW 4 (+26), FL 4 (+13).
Props/slops ('Me for sucking / Sam for sucking even more') read as mild banter, not a hold.
